title: Environmentally persistent free radicals on micro- and nano-plastics: a double-edged sword to environmental and biological safety
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,4768-4795
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00471C, Critical Review
Fangyu Hu, Sunyuxuan Lin, Kaili Wang, Mengxiang Cui, Jing Liu, Tao Wu, Chaoxiu Ren
